end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying changes by checking whether a new substance forms and used signs such as gas, colour change, smell, heat, light, or a new solid. They correctly separated melting from dissolving and explained that dissolved sugar or salt is still present and adds to the total mass. They mixed up reversibility as a deciding rule, but later stated that not being reversible is not conclusive; at home, ask them to classify examples by looking first for evidence of a new substance.

skills.skill: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples
Classify everyday changes using evidence, knowing that 'can it be reversed?' is a clue but not the rule
Tell melting apart from dissolving and know that dissolved substances are still present
Define a chemical change (a new substance with new properties forms) and recognise its signs: gas, colour change, heat or light, new smell, new solid

topic.title: Physical and chemical changes
topic.chapter: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical

agent.plan: Railing ke naye padarth ka saboot pakka; ab aluminium dhakkan se physical change mein no-new-substance jaanchna; phir reversibility ko sirf clue rakhna.

turns.text: Physical hai, kyunki pighalne ke baad bhi ghee wahi ghee hai na, bas solid se liquid hua. Jaise ice cream pighal jaati hai garmi mein, par ice cream hi rehti hai bas melt ho jaati hai. Waise ice cream dikhao na please?

Aapka point hai ki pighalne par ghee hi rehta hai, bas thos se taral hota hai. Ice cream ki picture abhi nahi bana sakti; sochiye, scoop pighal kar behne lagta hai. Ab mombatti mein wax pighalne aur baati jalne mein kaunsa physical, kaunsa chemical badlav hai, aur kya saboot hai?

Wax pighalna physical hoga jaise ghee pighla tha na, kyunki wapas jam sakta hai. Aur baati ka jalna chemical, kyunki usme se aag aur dhuan nikalta hai, to naya cheez ban raha hoga. Waise drawing mein dikhao na, wax ka puddle aur baati ki flame?
Aapne wax aur baati ke liye alag saboot bataye. Drawing abhi nahi bana sakti, par unka chhota sketch dikhati hoon. Ab jalne ke alawa chemical badlav ke do aur sanket kya ho sakte hain?

Accha, ek to colour change hota hai na. Jaise didi ne apple kaat ke rakha to brown ho gaya tha, wo chemical hai. Aur ek... smell bhi change hoti hai, kabhi kabhi... matlab pata nahi, kuch bhi ho sakta hai. Waise, ek example dikhao na colour change ka?

Aapne colour aur smell change ka zikr kiya, aur kate seb ka example bhi diya. Colour ka example dekhiye: kata seb kuch der hawa mein rahe toh uski satah bhoori ho sakti hai. Agar ek tukda khula rakhein aur doosra nimbu-paani mein, kaunsa jaldi bhoora hoga, aur bhoora hona physical badlav hai ya chemical?

Khula wala jaldi bhoora hoga na, kyunki mummy ne bataya tha. Aur chemical badlav hai kyunki colour change ho raha hai, brown colour ka naya cheez ban raha hai. Waise lekin agar wapas nimbu laga dein to kya wapas safed ho sakta hai? Didi ne kaha tha ki halka nimbu lagane se apple wapas theek ho jata hai. To kya ye reversible hai? Agar reversible hai to physical hona chahiye na? Par aapne kaha colou

Aap pooch rahi hain ki nimbu lagane se bhoora seb wapas pehle jaisa hota hai kya. Nimbu pehle lagane se bhoora hona dheema pad sakta hai; baad mein lagane se asli badlav ulta nahi hota. Aur sirf wapas na badal paana chemical ka pakka saboot nahi hai. Poster kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein chemical badlav kaunsa hai, aur kyun?

Sparkler wala chemical hoga, kyunki usme aag aur light bhi nikalti hai na, jaise patakhe mein. Poster kaatna to bas shape change hai, physical... lekin wapas jod nahi sakte, isiliye? Par aapne kaha wapas na kar paana chemical ka pakka saboot nahi... to kaise pata chalega fir? Accha, ek baat batao, sparkler ki photo dikhao na, kaise chamakta hai?

Haan, sparkler jalna chemical aur poster kaatna physical hai; aapne dono sahi pehchaane. Photo abhi nahi dikha sakti: sochiye, patli stick se chamakti chingariyan nikalti hain aur jalne ke baad raakh jaisa naya padarth bachta hai. Poster ki strips mein kaagaz hi rehta hai, bhale unhein pehle jaisa jodna mushkil ho. Ab dhoop mein rakha doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical hai ya chemical, aur kya saboot hai?

Chemical hoga na, kyunki smell change ho rahi hai, khatti smell aati hai na doodh se. Aur wo phat jaata hai to naya solid type cheez banta hai jaise paneer, to wo naya substance hai. Waise lekin garmi mein doodh ko fridge mein rakh do to wapas theek ho jata hai? Nahi, par... matlab phatne ke baad to nahi. Par mummy ne kal hi kaha tha ki doodh phat gaya to usse paneer bana lenge, to wo paneer ko wa

Haan, khatti smell aur phatne par alag thos hissa banna aapne sahi pakda. Saboot ko poora karne ke liye yeh bhi dekhiye: doodh se alag gunon wala khatta, jama hua padarth banta hai. Fridge mein pehle rakhne se doodh phatna dheema ho sakta hai, par phatne ke baad paneer ko wapas doodh nahi bana sakte. Ab mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav kya ho sakta hai?

Accha... physical badlav hoga na jaise ghee pighalna? Par mithai mein... pata nahi, sugar melt karna? Par wo to pehle bhi bola... aur chemical, wo doodh ka brown hona ya kuch? Actually, drawing mein dikhao na please, ek mithai ki drawing jisme ye sab ho raha ho?

Haan, ghee pighalna physical badlav ka sahi example hai. Mithai ki drawing abhi nahi bana sakti, par board par chhota sa sketch dikhati hoon: ghee liquid banta hai, aur doodh phatne par khatta jama hissa banta hai. Aapne sugar melt karne ki baat ki; ab Kunal namak ko paani mein hilaakar kehta hai ki woh pighal gaya, toh use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye aur pighalne se kya fark hai?

Namak pighalta nahi hai, wo... matlab wo dissolve ho jaata hai paani mein. Pighalna alag hai, usme solid bas garam hone se liquid banta hai, jaise ice. Lekin namak to paani mein gayab ho jaata hai, dikhta nahi par hai andar. Waise, ye jo whiteboard pe likha hai 'namak + paani → ?', iska matlab kya hai? Aur... ek baat, paani mein namak daalne ka video dikhao na, kaise wo chhote chhote tukdon mein t

Aapne namak ke liye dissolve aur barf ke liye pighalna kaha. Board ka teer matlab hai: namak paani mein milne ke baad kya hota hai? Video abhi nahi dikha sakti; sochiye, namak ke chhote kan paani mein fail jaate hain, isliye dikhte nahi. Agar paani ka glass tolkar usmein do chammach cheeni ghol dein, toh wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?

Wazan to badhega na, kyunki cheeni daal di na humne. Paani mein mil gayi to dikhti nahi par hai to andar hi, to total wazan badh jaana chahiye. Waise, iska drawing banao na, ek taraf glass aur dusri taraf wazan ka number type?

Aap keh rahi hain ki cheeni dikhna band hone par bhi paani mein rehti hai. Drawing abhi nahi bana sakti, par board par dono glass aur unke wazan ka chhota sketch dikhati hoon. Ab do drinks sochiye: ek mein room-temperature paani mein sugar ghulti hai, aur doosre mein chocolate garam karke liquid banti hai. Dono mein se dissolving kaunsa hai, aur melting kaunsa?

Dissolving to sugar wala kar raha hai, kyunki wo paani mein mil raha hai aur dikhna band ho raha hai. Chocolate wala melting hai, kyunki wo bas garam hone se liquid ban raha hai, usme kuch aur nahi mila. Aur haan, sugar abhi bhi maujood hai paani mein, bas chhupa hua hai, jaise aapne likha 'andar hai'. Waise, ek baat, ye drawing mein C kya hai? Cheeni ka weight? To P+C ka matlab total weight hai n

Bilkul, C cheeni ka wazan hai, aur P plus C paani aur cheeni ka kul wazan. Aapne sugar ka ghulna aur chocolate ka pighalna sahi alag kiya; cheeni paani mein ab bhi hai. Ab do saaf solutions milne par mixture dhundhla ho jaaye aur safed thos padarth dikhe, to chemical change ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?

Arre, safed solid dikh raha hai to wo naya substance ban gaya na! Jaise didi ne bataya tha ki chemical change mein naya cheez banta hai. To sabse mazboot saboot hai naya padarth jo pehle nahi tha. Waise, ye dhundhla hone ka drawing dikhao na, kaise saaf se dhundhla ho gaya?

Bilkul, pehle na dikhne wala safed thos padarth banna sabse mazboot saboot hai. Drawing abhi nahi bana sakti, par board par saaf se dhundhla hone ka chhota sketch dikhati hoon. Ab baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat bane, jiske gun iron se alag hain: yeh physical change hai ya chemical change?

Laal-bhoori parat... to wo chemical hui na, kyunki naya substance ban gaya, uska rang aur gun alag hai iron se. Jaise didi ne abhi kaha, naya padarth banna chemical ka saboot hai. Waise, ye laal-bhoori parat ki photo dikhao na, kaise dikhti hai railing pe?

Bilkul, railing par alag gun wali laal-bhoori parat banna chemical change hai. Photo abhi nahi dikha sakti; baarish mein iron railing par jagah-jagah laal-bhoore, khurdure daag sochiye. Ab aluminium sheet dabakar lunchbox ka dhakkan bane, aur kuch milaya na jaaye, to yeh physical change hai ya chemical?
